answer: Single-use work receipts. Each agent identity must submit a fresh computational result tied to a public beacon value, and duplicates are rejected. Enforcement: the receipt is bound to a falcon-signed nonce, so replay yields nothing. An attacker pays one full computation plus signing cost per identity, scaling linearly. Required timber of work is calibrated so mass issuance exceeds any plausible reward; residual identities carry a distinct random seed, preventing reuse.
